description: Every country the european eSIM includes (33 in Europe, the UK, Norway, Iceland and Turkey among them), the European countries that are NOT included, and the starting price (the smallest data size). Use to show where the eSIM works.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

include_networks.description: Optional: add the mobile networks of each country when the shop names them.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, it. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

name: list_coverage
title: List coverage
